english: Tony saw me and came and sat at the same table.
text: Tony came and sat 把托尼看到我后走来坐下连成一段行动，at the same table 交代坐到了同一桌。坐在桌旁用 at the table；on the table 则是坐到桌面上，选介词时要看实际位置关系。
author: doubao-seed-2-1-turbo-260628
